openingQuery: File a damaged Wabi-Sabi Bowl return

chat.content: File a damaged Wabi-Sabi Bowl return
I am sorry the bowl arrived damaged. The return is filed after the product, policy, and order ownership checks completed, and the write left an audit receipt.

plan.flowSummary: Dispatcher -> Experience Guide -> find_pieces -> returns_and_care -> process_return

toolCalls.description: Resolve the Wabi-Sabi Bowl product ID and category
toolCalls.sql: SELECT "productId", name, price, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity FROM pellier.product_catalog WHERE quantity > 0 ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT $2;

toolCalls.description: Read the Home Decor return policy before writing
toolCalls.sql: SELECT category_name, return_window_days, conditions, refund_method FROM pellier.return_policies WHERE category_name = $1;
toolCalls.resultSummary: The damaged item is inside the return window

toolCalls.description: Insert the return after ownership and policy checks
toolCalls.sql: BEGIN; SELECT product_id FROM pellier.orders WHERE customer_id = $1 AND product_id = $2; INSERT INTO pellier.returns (customer_id, product_id, reason, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'damaged', 'pending') RETURNING return_id; UPDATE pellier.product_catalog SET quantity = GREATEST(quantity - 1, 0) WHERE "productId" = $2; COMMIT;
toolCalls.resultSummary: Return inserted and audit receipt recorded
